metrics.name: plans_active
metrics.question: How many active plan subscriptions do we have??
notes: Count subscription rows. A person with two active subscriptions counts twice.
Use the governed status column. A status of unknown is not active.
Take subscription counts from this table. subscription_start events are not plans.

metrics.name: subscribers_active
metrics.question: How many users hold an active subscription?
notes: Count people, not subscription rows. plans_active counts the rows.
Recompute the distinct count at every grain. Adding the business totals double-counts a person who is active in more than one business.
Use the governed status column. A status of unknown is not active.

metrics.name: plans_paid_active
metrics.question: How many active subscriptions are for a paid plan?
notes: This is plans_active with Free removed.
A Free plan with a zero price stays in plans_active and stays out of this metric.

metrics.name: plan_starts
metrics.question: How many subscriptions began within a certain date range?
notes: A start counts even when the subscription is later canceled, paused, or unknown.
The period is required. There is no default window.
Take starts from start_date on this table. subscription_start events are a different count.

refusals.title: Revenue is not a metric
refusals.body: The catalog has no revenue, ARR, or cash metric. active monthly price on the model mart is a list-price total, and it is not in metrics/.

refusals.title: Completion rate is not a metric
refusals.body: Completes are not a subset of opens, so a completion rate is not defined. content_completes and content_opens are not in the catalog.

refusals.title: User-level fields stay off this site
refusals.body: email, user_name, and age_band are restricted. This page only returns a metric from metrics/.

refusals.title: There is no point-in-time subscriber metric
refusals.body: status is the current value. A past date cannot be reconstructed from it. plan_starts counts subscriptions whose start_date falls in a period, which is a different question.

refusals.title: Subscription events are not plan counts
refusals.body: subscription_start and subscription_cancel are engagement events. Plan metrics are counted from fct_subscription.

refusals.title: That period is not in the catalog
refusals.body: plan_starts requires a period. The worked example on this site is 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30.

refusals.title: That question is not in the catalog
refusals.body: The page can answer plans_active, subscribers_active, plans_paid_active, and plan_starts. It will not invent another metric.
